name: Amakuchi Shimai
source:
This visual novel is about a company worker
who lives next to sisters Hikari and Mai,
of which he's find and they always hang out together.

After a long day at work he comes home exhausted.
When he opens the door to the entrance...

这部视觉小说讲述一名公司职员的故事。他住在光与舞姐妹旁边，和她们关系很好，经常一起玩。

漫长工作日结束后，他疲惫地回到家。当他打开玄关的门……
